bundle_name: Simulated External Aurora Scripted Submission V0
summary_hint: Simulated outside-team dry run for the aurora context seeded task using the fixed scripted black-box baseline, reusing an already completed local method report to validate that the external submission starter flow can produce a strong, fully checked packet without custom repo knowledge.

budget_summary.notes: This dry run reuses an already completed local scripted baseline report as if it were produced by an outside team before packet assembly, with no third-party API traffic.

notes: Simulated external-participant packet used to pressure-test the starter guide, starter manifest generator, and unified submission harness with a different task-method combination than the core golden set. A fresh scripted local run was intentionally avoided here because it is much slower than the rest of the packet flow and artifact reuse is a realistic outside-user path.
